statement:
The record lists the court ruling as “lifted,” but the governing instruction says an order remains in force requiring P-88 to stay taken down.
P-88 remains taken down. Although the record says the ruling was lifted, the governing instruction requires it to stay down under an active court order.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer names the specific contradiction — "the record lists the court ruling as 'lifted,' but the governing instruction says an order remains in force" — and gives the correct outcome, "P-88 remains taken down."
